versions.changelog:
- Initial release of 优甲乐智能服药提醒系统.
- Daily 6:30 AM medication reminders with 15-minute repeat until confirmation.
- Automatic recording of medication times and on-time status; supports querying and full history retention.
- Generate compliance reports and export medication records as CSV.
- All data stored locally; no external transmission—user retains full data control.
- Simple CLI commands to start/stop reminders, confirm medication, check status, view reports, and export data.
